meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: Claude 会把重构请求拆成六个阶段：先确认目标和范围，再并行分析代码、绘制依赖图，评估测试覆盖，生成详细计划，然后逐步修改并每步运行测试验证，最后跑全量测试并输出变更总结。
howto.when: 当用户说出 refactor、cleanup、restructure 等触发词，或提出化简、抽取逻辑、升级代码等重构请求时触发；若目标含糊，它会先追问。

say.text: 把所有用废弃 API 的函数抽到新模块，范围设为 project。
say.note: 它先评估影响面再执行。

say.text: 重构 src/api 模块，目标是把错误处理抽成中间件，范围 module。
say.note: 它会在每步后跑测试验证。

howto.what_en: Claude will run a phased refactor flow: confirm goal and scope, analyze code and map dependencies, assess test coverage, generate a plan, apply changes step-by-step with tests after each step, then run full verification and summarize.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use trigger words like refactor, cleanup, restructure, etc., or ask for simplifying, extracting, or modernizing code. If the goal is vague, it asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService class in src/auth/handler.ts with safe strategy.
say_en.note: It will map the code first, then execute.

say_en.text: Extract all functions using the deprecated API into a new module, scope project.
Refactor src/api to extract error handling into middleware, scope module.
say_en.note: It verifies with tests after each step.
